title: Mapping adipocyte interactome networks by HaloTag-enrichment-mass spectrometry.
authors: Yazaki, Junshi; Yamanashi, Takashi; Nemoto, Shino; Kobayashi, Atsuo; Han, Yong-Woon; Hasegawa, Tomoko; Iwase, Akira; Ishikawa, Masaki; Konno, Ryo; Imami, Koshi; Kawashima, Yusuke; Seita, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文用HaloTag富集质谱绘制脂肪细胞蛋白互作网络，虽涉及TF-蛋白复合物，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA结合，且AI仅用于验证，缺乏TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Mapping protein interaction complexes in their natural state in vivo is arguably the Holy Grail of protein network analysis. Detection of protein interaction stoichiometry has been an important technical challenge, as few studies have focused on this. This may, however, be solved by artificial intelligence (AI) and proteomics. Here, we describe the development of HaloTag-based affinity purification mass spectrometry (HaloMS), a high-throughput HaloMS assay for protein interaction discovery. The approach enables the rapid capture of newly expressed proteins, eliminating tedious conventional one-by-one assays. As a proof-of-principle, we used HaloMS to evaluate the protein complex interactions of 17 regulatory proteins in human adipocytes. The adipocyte interactome network was validated using an in vitro pull-down assay and AI-based prediction tools. Applying HaloMS to probe adipocyte differentiation facilitated the identification of previously unknown transcription factor (TF)-protein complexes, revealing proteome-wide human adipocyte TF networks and shedding light on how different pathways are integrated.
abstract_zh: 在体内自然状态下绘制蛋白质相互作用复合物，可以说是蛋白质网络分析的“圣杯”。蛋白质相互作用化学计量比的检测一直是一项重要的技术挑战，因为很少有研究关注这一点。然而，这或许可以通过人工智能（AI）和蛋白质组学来解决。在此，我们描述了基于HaloTag的亲和纯化质谱法（HaloMS）的开发，这是一种用于蛋白质相互作用发现的高通量HaloMS检测方法。该方法能够快速捕获新表达的蛋白质，省去了繁琐的传统逐一检测流程。作为原理验证，我们使用HaloMS评估了人类脂肪细胞中17种调控蛋白的蛋白质复合物相互作用。脂肪细胞相互作用组网络通过体外下拉实验和基于AI的预测工具进行了验证。应用HaloMS探测脂肪细胞分化，有助于识别先前未知的转录因子（TF）-蛋白质复合物，揭示了蛋白质组范围内的人类脂肪细胞TF网络，并阐明了不同通路如何被整合。
